sameCredentials: Use the same login username and password for outgoing mail
verifying: Verifying incoming and outgoing mail and saving securely…
accountHint: Passwords are used for authentication and stored in the system credential store, never in the database or browser storage.
googleHint: Gmail OAuth requires a registered client configuration. This form only works with accounts that permit app passwords.
pageSearchHint: Filters subjects and senders on this page only. Full-text search is not connected.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this account and remove its credentials? Downloaded messages will be retained.
syncMore: Batch progress saved; more messages remain
statusHint: Unread count covers this page only. The time is the latest successful synchronization batch in this session.
noMessages: No synchronized messages in this folder
cacheHint: Opening a message caches its body and attachments. HTML is displayed as safe text only.
subject: Subject
sent: The outgoing server accepted the message
composeHint: Plain-text sending only. Drafts are not automatically saved; sent copies are managed by the provider.
desktopRequired: Use the desktop app for email features
error_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE: The desktop mail service is unavailable. Retry in the desktop app.
error_AUTH_INVALID: The server rejected authentication. Check the username, password or app password and IMAP/SMTP access.
error_TLS_REQUIRED: A trusted encrypted connection could not be established. Check the host, port and certificate.
error_NETWORK_FAILED: The mail server could not be reached. Check your network and server settings.
error_MAIL_PROTOCOL_FAILED: The server response or message format is unsupported. Retry later.
error_MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE: A safety limit was exceeded: 40 MiB per message, 25 MiB per attachment, 1 MiB of text.
error_OAUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED: This authorization method needs a registered OAuth client configuration, which is not available.
error_CREDENTIAL_MISSING: Account credentials are missing. Disconnect and add the account again.
error_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE: The system credential store is unavailable or access was denied. Account setup was not completed.
error_INVALID_CREDENTIAL: The password or credential reference is invalid. Check its length and contents.
error_INVALID_INPUT: An account, server or recipient field is invalid. Check the input.
error_STORAGE_FAILED: Local storage failed. Check available disk space or retry.
error_BUSY: This account is processing another operation. Retry shortly.
error_TIMEOUT: The operation timed out. Completed synchronization batches are retained.
error_SEND_UNCERTAIN: Delivery is uncertain. Check the provider's Sent folder before attempting to send again.
error_CREDENTIAL_CLEANUP_FAILED: Saving failed and temporary credentials could not be fully removed. Check the system credential store.
error_SAVE_FAILED: The attachment could not be saved. Choose a new filename and check directory permissions.
